facts.note: stated as true: some narrow straits' tide runs like a river and stops and reverses every few hours; that current is stronger than oars; only a few ships fit through narrows at once. Everything else is invented story (by design in this form, so the spec's 4-7 facts doesn't apply as-is)

jokes.note: 'you're parking?'; the sea doing all the rowing; captains politely letting him face the enemy first; close enough to spit on; close enough to wave goodbye; the captain says it was his idea

reversal.note: the current that carried them in drives them out; the mocker claims the credit

ridicule.note: the enemy laughing; the captain's 'parking'; the thrilled enemy admiral

mechanism_visible.note: the cork slowing, stopping and reversing; anchored ships holding while theirs are shoved back

shootable_share.note: every line names a thing: anchor, collar, cork, fleet, admiral, cannons, flagship, jam

hook_act_on_screen.note: him at the bow letting the anchor go, the laughing fleet behind
